answers.rationale: award_remaining_balance records remaining_balance 15000 for award A-101 (award_amount 50000 minus disbursed_total 35000).
Award A-102 is in program SEED-FAST; both award_match_obligation and program_match_rule establish match_required no with match_rate 0, so no cash match is required.
Award A-101 belongs to org_id ORG-MEADOW (Meadow Community Trust). The award table lists A-101 and A-103 as the only awards for that organization.

A-101 is in SEED-CORE with a nominal 20% match obligation, but purpose_requirement_failure seed_core_waiver_unknown flags EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED: waiver letters are not in the packet, so whether cash match is actually required cannot be established.

Award A-104 has status_code S, which is absent from status_legend_entry and award_status_label. purpose_requirement_failure records both UNINTERPRETED (award_status_interpretable) and EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED (status_code_not_in_legend) for this code, so its meaning is not established.
award_status_label establishes Active status for A-101 (remaining_balance 15000) and A-102 (remaining_balance 0). Their combined remaining undisbursed balance is 15000.
